newsitem.title: UK: Country casuals downbeat on trading.
newsitem.headline: Country casuals downbeat on trading.

text.p: British clothing retailer Country Casuals Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it had seen a "significant deterioration" in group trading since the announcement of its interim results on October 9.

The company said that as a result of its third quarter trading performance and prospects for the rest of the year, it expected pretax profit for the year to January 25 1997, to be "materially below" current market forecasts but not less than one million stg.
It said that it did not intend to recommend the payment of a final dividend for the current year.
